title: Sequencer simulator test documentation still describes the fixed scripting binding token defect
description: Ticket 8ca68272 (commit 57762ed63) fixed the Scripting Agent change bindings so they forward the local device/master access token. Test documentation still describes that defect as current: indigo_test/integration/sequencer_simulators.md:27 says --native-bindings 'is expected to fail on the current production code'; indigo_test/integration/sequencer_simulators.js:433-434 has a comment about the 'documented native binding-token defect'; indigo_test/integration/run_sequencer_simulators.py:191 has --help text about the same defect. Update these texts to the current behavior. The remaining --native-bindings failure of 'restore private configuration' belongs to ticket 8f313dbc-765b-5e79-9cef-a9d8db5918f9 and is not part of this ticket. Text-only change; no test logic or production code changes.
